03-25-1504 is March 25, 1504.  
304 days later:  
March has 31 days, so March 25 → April 25 is 31 days (6 days left in March + 25 days in April? Let's compute properly).  

Days from March 25 to end of March: 31 - 25 = 6 days.  
Remaining days after March: 304 - 6 = 298 days.  

April 1504: 30 days → 298 - 30 = 268 left.  
May: 31 → 268 - 31 = 237 left.  
June: 30 → 237 - 30 = 207 left.  
July: 31 → 207 - 31 = 176 left.  
August: 31 → 176 - 31 = 145 left.  
September: 30 → 145 - 30 = 115 left.  
October: 31 → 115 - 31 = 84 left.  
November: 30 → 84 - 30 = 54 left.  
December: 31 → 54 - 31 = 23 left.  
January 1505: 31 → 23 days into January = January 23, 1505.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1505-01-23
